name: Colombia team sees receiving and delivery operations

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the configured local_team TestSprite credentials for the Colombia operator.
Verify the user reaches /local-team and can see consolidated boxes, manifests, pending deliveries, and payment-method controls.
Verify the local-team user cannot access USA seller shipment-creation operations or receive an admin-only success response.
If a seeded or available local test box exists, open its manifest and inspect the package/customer details without submitting a real payment.
Verify the local panel distinguishes Stripe, cash, and transfer collection and displays the local-fund/accounting summary.
